Rashi on Ketubot 41a:10:1.hebrew: מגופו - אינו גובה אלא מגוף השור, ואם אין בו כדי חצי נזקו, יפסיד המותר:
Rashi on Ketubot 41a:10:1.english: From its body - [The injured party] collects only from the body of the ox, and if there is not enough in it for half his damage, he loses the remainder.

Rashi on Ketubot 41a:10:2.hebrew: מן העלייה - מן המיטב שבנכסי מזיק, דגבי תם כתיב (שמות כ״א:ל״ו) "וחצו את כספו" — מגופו, ובמועד כתיב (שם) "שלם ישלם שור". ואם איתא דפלגא ניזקא קנסא, ניתני נמי שהתם אינו משלם על פי עצמו, ומועד משלם על פי עצמו, דמועד ודאי בדין משלם, שהרי התרו והעידו בו לשמור שורו:
Rashi on Ketubot 41a:10:2.english: From the superior [property] - From the best of the damager's property, for regarding an innocuous [ox] it is written (Exodus 21:36): "And they shall divide its money" — [meaning] from its body; whereas regarding a forewarned [ox] it is written (ibid.): "He shall surely pay an ox." And if it is so that half-damage is a fine, let [the baraita] also teach that an innocuous [ox] does not pay based on his own [admission], whereas a forewarned [ox] pays based on his own [admission], for a forewarned [ox] certainly pays by law, since they forewarned and testified against him to guard his ox.

Rashi on Ketubot 41a:11:1.hebrew: שייר חצי כופר - לא שנה כל החילוקים שביניהם, שהרי אף יש חילוק זה ביניהם, שהמועד שהמית את האדם משלם כופר שלם, ותם שהמית, אפילו חצי כופר כדינו בניזקין לא משלם. דכתיב [שמות כב] בעל השור נקי, ודרשינן (ב"ק דף מא:) נקי מחצי כופר:
Rashi on Ketubot 41a:11:1.english: He omitted half ransom - [The tanna] did not teach all the differences between them, for behold, there is also this difference between them: that a forewarned [ox] that killed a person pays full ransom, whereas an innocuous [ox] that killed does not pay even half ransom according to its [usual] law in damages. As it is written (Exodus 22 [21:28]): "The owner of the ox is clear," and we expound (Bava Kamma 41b): "clear of half ransom."

Rashi on Ketubot 41a:1:1.hebrew: פתיתי - בגמ' מפרש אמאי לא תנא אנסתי:
Rashi on Ketubot 41a:1:1.english: I seduced - In the Gemara, it explains why [the Tanna] did not teach, "I raped."

Rashi on Ketubot 41a:1:2.hebrew: ואינו משלם קנס - בבבא קמא נפקא לן מודה בקנס פטור, מ"אשר ירשיעון אלהים" — פרט למרשיע את עצמו:
Rashi on Ketubot 41a:1:2.english: And he does not pay the fine - In Bava Kamma we derive [that] one who admits to a fine is exempt, from [the verse] "whom the judges shall condemn" — excluding one who condemns himself.

Rashi on Ketubot 41a:1:3.english: My ox killed so-and-so - And I am liable for the ransom [payment].

Rashi on Ketubot 41a:1:4.hebrew: הרי זה משלם ע"פ עצמו - קסבר כופרא ממונא:
Rashi on Ketubot 41a:1:4.english: This [owner] pays based on his own [admission] - [He] holds [that] ransom is monetary compensation.

Rashi on Ketubot 41a:1:5.english: The slave of so-and-so - And behold, I am liable [to pay] thirty sela.

Rashi on Ketubot 41a:1:6.hebrew: אינו משלם - דקנס נינהו, שאפי' אין יפה דינר, נותן שלשים:
Rashi on Ketubot 41a:1:6.english: He does not pay - For they are a fine, as even if [the slave] is not worth a dinar, [the owner] gives thirty [sela].

Rashi on Ketubot 41a:2:1.hebrew: דלא פגים לה - אין לעז של אנוסה גדול כלעז של מפותה, וכיון דלאו פגם דילה הוא, מהימנינן ליה למשקל מיניה בושת ופגם על פיו:
Rashi on Ketubot 41a:2:1.english: Where he does not tarnish her - The stigma of a raped woman is not as great as the stigma of a seduced woman, and since it is not her degradation, we believe him to collect from him [compensation for] humiliation and degradation based on his own admission.

Rashi on Ketubot 41a:2:2.english: Say [that we do] not - believe him to substantiate the rumor.

Rashi on Ketubot 41a:3:1.english: It is not within his power - That he should spread a rumor about her [that she is] a harlot in the city.

Rashi on Ketubot 41a:4:1.english: She herself is amenable - to bear the stigma in order to gain the money.

Rashi on Ketubot 41a:4:2.hebrew: לא ניחא להו לבני משפחה - וב"ד אין עליהם לעשות דבר להחזיק בושתם:
Rashi on Ketubot 41a:4:2.english: The members of the family are not amenable - and the court is not obligated to do anything to confirm their disgrace.

Rashi on Ketubot 41a:5:1.english: [Money - and he pays based on his own admission]:

Rashi on Ketubot 41a:6:1.hebrew: לאו בחזקת שימור קיימי - אם לא ישמרום בעלים שלא יזיקו, [אינם בחזקת משתמרים מאליהם שלא יזיקו] אלא מזיקין אפי' ניזקא דלאו אורחיה. הלכך, על מרייהו רמיא לנטורינהו, וזה שלא שמרו בדין הוא דלישלם כולה, אלא דרחמנא חס עליה. ומיהו מה שמשלם, בדין משלם:
Rashi on Ketubot 41a:6:1.english: They do not exist in the presumptive status of being guarded - If [their] owners do not guard them so that they do not cause damage — [they are not presumed to guard themselves on their own so as not to cause damage] — rather, they cause damage, even damage that is not their [usual] way. Therefore, it is incumbent upon their owners to guard them, and this [owner] who did not guard his [ox] should by right pay the entire [damage], except that the Merciful One had compassion on him. Nevertheless, what he does pay, he pays by right.

Rashi on Ketubot 41a:6:2.english: So that he would guard it - That he should add guarding to his [existing] guarding.

Rashi on Ketubot 41a:7:2.hebrew: הניזק והמזיק בתשלומין - שניהם מפסידין בדבר. ס"ד דהכי קאמר: תרוייהו מטי להו בהאי פסידא, דניזק מפסיד פלגא ומזיק פלגא:
Rashi on Ketubot 41a:7:2.english: The damaged [party] and the damager [share] in the payments - Both of them suffer a loss in the matter. One might have thought that it is saying thus: both of them incur this loss, as the damaged [party] loses half and the damager [loses] half.

Rashi on Ketubot 41a:7:3.english: That is how the damaged party shares in the payments - For he loses half of his money.

Rashi on Ketubot 41a:7:4.english: That he takes [what is] not his - For what he takes, he takes gratuitously.

Rashi on Ketubot 41a:7:5.english: Is he [sharing] in the payments - [This is said] as a rhetorical question.

Rashi on Ketubot 41a:8:1.hebrew: לא נצרכא אלא לפחת נבילה - הא דקתני ניזק בתשלומין, לאו בפלגא דקא שביק קאמר, אלא בההוא פלגא ניזקא נמי דקני ליה רחמנא, מפסיד כל פחת שפחתה נבילה מדמיה משעת מיתה עד שעת העמדה בדין; ששמין את הנבלה כמה היה יפה השור בחייו וכמה היתה נבילה יפה בשעת מיתה, ומשלם החצי, אבל מה שהוזלו דמי נבילה משעת מיתה עד שעת מכירה, אין המזיק משלם כלום באותו פחת. ובבבא קמא (דף י:) יליף לה מקראי, ואשמעינן האי תנא דפחת נבילה דניזק הוי:
Rashi on Ketubot 41a:8:1.english: It is necessary only for the depreciation of the carcass - That which [the Tanna] teaches, "[the] injured party [shares] in the payment," does not refer to the half [of the damage] that he forgoes; rather, even in that half-damage that the Merciful One granted him, [the injured party] loses all the depreciation that the carcass depreciated in value from the time of death until the time of standing in court. For they appraise the carcass — how much the ox was worth when alive and how much the carcass was worth at the time of death — and [the damager] pays half [the difference]; however, as for the amount by which the value of the carcass declined from the time of death until the time of sale, the damager does not pay anything toward that depreciation. And in Bava Kamma (10b), [the Gemara] derives this from verses, and this Tanna teaches us that the depreciation of the carcass belongs to the injured party.

Rashi on Ketubot 41a:8:2.hebrew: תשלומי נזק מלמד שהבעלים מטפלין בנבילה - תנא דברייתא דריש לישנא דמתניתין, דתנן בבבא קמא: "משלם תשלומי נזק במיטב הארץ", ותנא עלה בברייתא, דהאי דנקט תנא דמתני' "תשלומי נזק" ולא תנא "משלם את הנזק", לאשמועינן אתא שהניזק נוטל את נבילתו ומטפל בה ומוכרה, והמזיק משלים עליה מה שחייבתו תורה — אם תם חצי, ואם מועד הכל. ותרתי למה ליה לרבי למיסתם במתני' דבעלים מטפלין בנבילה:
Rashi on Ketubot 41a:8:2.english: Payments of damage teaches that the owners tend to the carcass - The Tanna of the baraita is expounding the wording of the Mishnah, as we learned in Bava Kamma: "[He] pays payments of damage with the best of the land," and [a Tanna] taught regarding it in a baraita that [the reason] the Tanna of the Mishnah used [the phrase] "payments of damage" and did not teach "pays the damage" is to teach us that the injured party takes his carcass, tends to it, and sells it, and the damager makes up upon it what the Torah obligated him — if [it was] a tam [innocuous ox], half, and if [it was] a mu'ad [forewarned ox], all [of it]. And why did Rebbi need to state twice anonymously in the Mishnah that [the] owners tend to the carcass?

Rashi on Ketubot 41a:9:1.english: That he pays all of it - And this loss is sufficient for him.

Tosafot on Ketubot 41a:11:1.hebrew: אי משום חצי כופר לאו שיורא הוא וכו' - לאו פירכא היא, אלא שינויא הוא, דלא תיקשי למ"ד פלגא ניזקא ממונא: מאי שייר דשייר חצי כופר? ומשני: לא שייר כלום, וחצי כופר לאו שיורא הוא. וכן איכא בנזיר בפ' ג' מינים (נזיר דף לח: ושם) גבי "אי משום לא יחל לאו שיורא הוא", וכן בפרק החליל (סוכה דף נד. ושם), וההוא דהתם מגומגם טפי:
Tosafot on Ketubot 41a:11:1.english: "If [it is] due to the half ransom, it is not an omission," etc. - This is not a refutation, rather it is a resolution, so that there will not be a difficulty according to the one who says half-damage is monetary [compensation]: "What [else] did he omit that he omitted half ransom?" And [the Gemara] answers: He did not omit anything, and half ransom is not an omission. And similarly there is [a case like this] in Nazir, in the chapter [entitled] Sheloshah Minim (Nazir 38b and there), regarding "If [it is] due to 'he shall not profane,' it is not an omission," and similarly in the chapter [entitled] Hechalil (Sukkah 54a and there), and that [passage] there is even more awkward.

Tosafot on Ketubot 41a:1:1.hebrew: האומר גנבתי כו' - מוציא ש"ר ויוצא בשן ועין דלא תנא, איכא למימר דאתיא בזה הכלל:
Tosafot on Ketubot 41a:1:1.english: "One who says: I stole," etc. - [Regarding] a defamer and [a slave] who goes free through [loss of] a tooth or eye, which [the Mishnah] did not teach — one can say that they are included in "This is the principle."

Tosafot on Ketubot 41a:1:2.hebrew: זה הכלל כל המשלם יותר על מה שהזיק כו' - ואפילו למ"ד בפרק שור שנגח ארבעה וחמשה (ב"ק דף מ.) דכופר היינו דמי המזיק, לא חשיב יותר ממה שהזיק, אע"פ שפעמים שוה מזיק יותר מניזק, דפדיון נפשו הוא נותן:
Tosafot on Ketubot 41a:1:2.english: "This is the principle: Anyone who pays more than what he damaged, etc." - And even according to the one who says in the chapter [entitled] Shor SheNagach Arba'ah VaChamishah (Bava Kamma 40a) that kofer [ransom] is the value of the damager, it is not considered "more than what he damaged," even though sometimes the damager is worth more than the victim, because he is giving the redemption of his own life.

Tosafot on Ketubot 41a:2:1.hebrew: וליתני אנסתי - דהוי חדוש טפי, דפטור אע"ג דמודה שעשה פריצות:
Tosafot on Ketubot 41a:2:1.english: And let [the Mishnah] teach "I raped" - For it would be a greater novelty that he is exempt [from the fine], even though he admits that he committed an act of licentiousness.

Tosafot on Ketubot 41a:3:1.hebrew: רבי שמעון בן יהודה אומר אף בושת ופגם אינו משלם ע"פ עצמו - אור"י, דאי קאי ר"ש בן יהודה אמתניתין דהכא, הא דמשמע בריש נערה לקמן (כתובות דף מב.) דלר"ש אי דקא תבע בושת ופגם מחייב ליה קרבן שבועה — היינו משום דהתם תבעו האב תחלה, ואין שייך לומר "לאו כל הימנו כו'" כדקאמר הכא, ואין צריך לומר דתרי תנאי אליבא דר' שמעון. ועוד אומר רשב"א, דההיא דלקמן איכא לאוקמי בבת גרים, וניחא לה לדידה ולאביה, דליכא למימר דלמא איכא חד במדינת הים דלא ניחא ליה. ומיהו, אי קאי ר' שמעון אמתניתין דשבועות דמייתי לקמן בריש נערה (ג"ז שם), ע"כ תרי תנאי אליבא דר' שמעון:
Tosafot on Ketubot 41a:3:1.english: "Rabbi Shimon ben Yehuda says: Even [payments for] humiliation and degradation he does not pay on his own admission" - Rabbi Yitzchak says that if Rabbi Shimon ben Yehuda is referring to our Mishnah here, that which is implied at the beginning of [the chapter] Na'arah later (Ketubot 42a) — that according to Rabbi Shimon, if [the father] is claiming humiliation and degradation, he obligates him [in] an oath-offering — is because there the father sued him first, so it is not applicable to say "it is not within his power, etc.," as [the Gemara] says here; and it is not necessary to say that [there are] two Tannaim regarding the opinion of Rabbi Shimon. And furthermore, Rabbi Shimshon ben Avraham says that that [case] later can be established [as referring] to the daughter of converts, and it is satisfactory to her and to her father, so one cannot say "perhaps there is one [relative] overseas who is not satisfied [with it]." However, if Rabbi Shimon [ben Yehuda] is referring to the Mishnah of Shevuot that [the Gemara] cites later at the beginning of Na'arah (ibid.), perforce [there are] two Tannaim regarding the opinion of Rabbi Shimon.

Tosafot on Ketubot 41a:8:1.hebrew: לא נצרכא אלא לפחת נבילה - אע"ג דלאו דידיה שקיל, מ"מ כיון דזכי ליה רחמנא חצי נזק, חשבינן ליה בתשלומין מה שפחתה הנבלה. והכא לא שייך למימר "קרנא דתורך קבירא ביה", כדאמרי' בהמניח בסופו (ב"ק דף לד.) — דהתם, ודאי שלא נהרג השור, שייך לומר הכי, דאין לו למכור שורו בשביל כן, שסבור שישביח; אבל הכא, מיד כשנהרג יש לו למוכרו, שידוע שתפחת הנבילה ותסריח:
Tosafot on Ketubot 41a:8:1.english: "It is needed only for the depreciation of the carcass" - Even though he [the injured party] takes what is not [rightfully] his, nevertheless, since the Merciful One granted him half-damages, we count [the amount] by which the carcass depreciated as [his share] in the payments. And here it is not applicable to say, "The horn of your ox is buried in it," as we say at the end of [the chapter] HaManiach (Bava Kamma 34a) — for there, indeed, where the ox was not killed, it is applicable to say this, because he does not have to sell his ox on account of that, as he thinks that it will improve; but here, as soon as it is killed, he must sell it, for it is known that the carcass will depreciate and putrefy.

Tosafot on Ketubot 41a:8:2.hebrew: תנינא תשלומי נזק מלמד שהבעלים מטפלים בנבילה כו' - הכי דייקא לה בבבא קמא (דף י:): "חבתי בנזקו" לא קתני, אלא "בתשלומי נזקו" כו':
Tosafot on Ketubot 41a:8:2.english: We learned: "Payments of damage teaches that the owners tend to the carcass," etc. - This is how [the Gemara] derives it in Bava Kamma (10b): It does not teach "I am liable for his damage," rather "for the payments of his damage," etc.
